service.army: United States Army, September 1975 – August 1995 (20 years). Infantry; drill sergeant from 1988. Stations: Germany; Fort Sill, Oklahoma (1988–1991); Washington (1992); Guam (1994–1995); retired in Washington.

viewing.title: Viewing & Rosary
viewing.notes: Come any time during the viewing. The family prays the Rosary together at 1:00 PM.

funeralMass.title: Funeral Mass
funeralMass.timeDisplay: Mass begins promptly at 10:00 AM · Rosary at 9:00 AM
funeralMass.venueName: St. John of the Woods Catholic Church
whatToExpect: 9:00 AM — the family prays the Rosary together.
The casket is open for family to pay their respects until Mass begins.
funeralMass.reception: TBD — none confirmed. If a repast follows, add location and time here.
funeralMass.notes: Please arrive by 9:30 AM so you are seated before Mass begins.

interment.title: Interment with Military Honors
interment.warning: The cemetery runs on a strict military schedule and cannot hold a service for late arrivals. It is a Friday morning — allow extra time for traffic and construction, and plan to leave early.

orderOfService.detail: Vincent Calip, followed by family and friends — placement to be confirmed with Father Tuan

program.acknowledgments: The family of Patrick Cabrera thanks everyone who has surrounded us with prayers, food, and presence these past weeks. Your kindness reflects the man we are honoring. Special thanks to Father Tuan, Father Hendry, the St. John of the Woods Lazarus Ministry, and the staff of Mountain View Funeral Home.
